description: Look up rule metadata (title, description, fixAtSource, sourceFixGuidance, severity, classification, wcagCriteria) for one or more ruleCodes. The saved scan JSON linked from each `audioeye_scan` report embeds trimmed metadata for every failed rule under `metadata[ruleCode]`; call this tool when that file is not at hand or its guidance was truncated. Every known ruleCode resolves from the built-in rule catalogue even before the first scan; scans in the current process enrich those entries. Only an unrecognized ruleCode appears in `missing`.

ruleCodes.description: Array of ruleCodes to look up. Required and non-empty.

name: audioeye_get_rule_metadata
title: Look up rule metadata
